patch.value: Expose a bounded, credential-free explanation for a verified lifecycle event, combining eligibility, ordered routing, attention policy and durable delivery evidence.
Each fixture event has one complete decision path; urgent bypass names its policy; suppressed events are diagnosable in one bounded command with zero network calls.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Overlap check against the current CLI and sibling pm-ops: CLI provides item/history/status SDK primitives, not Slack routing explanations. Existing pm-slack outbox records delivery and coalescing plans account for attention; pm-ops diagnostics do not own Slack attention semantics. Add an offline read-only explanation, reusing verified SDK history and existing routing/planner logic. No import/export/sync or journal mutation is introduced. Historical routes were not snapshotted, so distinguish retained evidence from current-policy evaluation and explicit uncertainty.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Implemented exact-revision SDK and CLI diagnosis with verified history replay, configured status roles, retained eligibility, ordered current routing, named attention policy, and receipt outcome. Reads existing SQLite storage in one read-only snapshot; no new shared mutable state or import/export/sync/journal path. Targeted suite passes 8 tests including 500 seeded policy sequences replaying older SDK revisions with CRLF variants and SDK read-back state comparisons, 12 randomized custom registries, all transport states, foreign-record skips and competing transitions at every read SQL boundary. Core output contract coverage is 100/100/100; full unchanged release thresholds will be verified in CI.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Resuming PR 160 after read-only review: skipped is an operator work state and cannot prove non-delivery after an ambiguous attempt. Audit all receipt-to-outcome surfaces, persist attempt evidence under the existing writer transaction, centralize outcome reduction, preserve uncertainty through all operator resolutions, and add at least 500 real send/resolve lifecycle sequences with a recording synthetic Slack reference model. Existing source work and public-data evidence will be retained.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Class-level audit found only three receipt reporting surfaces: routing explanation, outbox status/drain, and coalescing preview/retained manifests plus their TOON renderers. All now use deriveSlackDeliveryOutcome; compatibility state counts remain work-state counts, with independent outcome totals. Tracker digest counters are activity, not delivery, and remain unchanged. Claims/results and operator resolutions are retained separately under the existing SQLite writer fence; late completions update only their own evidence. A monotonic claim counter makes gaps conservative. The first 500-sequence recording-Slack run passed (644 requests; 78 delivered, 150 withheld, 272 uncertain); stronger random operation mixing and final focused/CI checks follow. Any unresolved attempt dominates later labels or acknowledgments under the requested any-attempt uncertainty rule.
